Why SELLO Retail

The problem

Busy shops need billing that is fast at the counter, stock that stays accurate, and credit customers who are easy to follow up — without paying a monthly cloud fee or stopping when the internet drops.

Our solution

SELLO Retail runs on the counter PC, a tablet or a phone, with an encrypted database on the device. Billing, stock, purchases, customers, installments, ledgers, shifts and reports all work offline, in English, Arabic or Hindi, with the right tax for India, the UAE or Saudi Arabia.

// 05

Key features

  1. 01

    Scan-and-bill

    Barcode or name search, item and bill discounts, hold and resume, returns and exchanges, F1 / F2 / F12 shortcuts.

  2. 02

    Every way to pay

    Cash with change, card, UPI with QR, bank transfer, credit, installments and split payments.

  3. 03

    Customer display

    A second screen shows each item, the tax and the total as you scan, plus the UPI QR to pay.

  4. 04

    Products & stock

    Barcodes, variants, batch and expiry, low-stock alerts, stock adjustments, Excel import/export and bulk edit.

  5. 05

    Barcode labels

    Generate barcodes for products that have none and print labels.

  6. 06

    Purchases & suppliers

    Stock in from suppliers — and scan a supplier’s paper bill to fill the purchase in.

  7. 07

    Customers & installments

    Credit limits, installment plans with due dates, payments and printable receipts.

  8. 08

    Ledgers & expenses

    Customer and supplier ledgers, cash book, bank book, expenses and multiple bank accounts.

  9. 09

    Shifts

    Opening cash, and an automatic shift report with expected vs counted cash at closing.

  10. 10

    Reports & dashboard

    Sales, cashier, item, category, tax, HSN, profit and stock reports — PDF, Excel, CSV, WhatsApp or email.

  11. 11

    Tax for 3 countries

    India GST (CGST, SGST, IGST), UAE VAT and Saudi VAT, with support for ZATCA e-invoicing.

  12. 12

    Roles & security

    Owner, manager, cashier and stock-keeper roles, PIN lock, auto-lock and a full audit log.

// 06

How it works

  1. Step 1

    Install SELLO Retail on the counter PC, tablet or phone — each starts with a 7-day free trial.

  2. Step 2

    Set up the shop: country and tax, products (or import them from Excel), printers and users.

  3. Step 3

    Bill at the counter: scan, take payment and print or share the bill, with the customer display showing the total.

  4. Step 4

    Close each shift with its report, follow up credit and installments, and check the dashboard and reports.

// 08

Under the hood

Technical overview

Flutter app for Windows, Android and iOS with an encrypted SQLite database (SQLCipher) on the device. Money is stored in the smallest currency unit and tax is rounded per line by country. Prints to 58 / 80 mm thermal printers over USB, Bluetooth or network, and A4. Supplier-bill scanning reads text on the device without internet. Licensed by offline activation codes: 7-day trial, then 1, 2, 3 or 5-year plans.

Data & privacy

Shop, sales and customer data is stored encrypted on your own device — not on a third-party cloud. Backup and restore to a file is built in.

// 09

FAQ

Does SELLO Retail need the internet?

No. Billing, stock, customers and reports all work offline on the device.

Which devices does it run on?

Windows PCs, Android tablets and Android phones. An iPad / iPhone version is also available.

Does it support GST and VAT?

Yes — India GST (CGST, SGST, IGST), UAE VAT and Saudi VAT, with tax-inclusive or exclusive prices.

Can I sell on installments?

Yes. Set a down payment and installments with due dates; SELLO Retail tracks what is paid, due and overdue.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. Every install starts with a 7-day free trial; after that, an activation code unlocks a 1, 2, 3 or 5-year plan.

Do you supply POS hardware too?

Yes. We supply complete POS systems — terminals, tablets, printers, scanners and cash drawers — with SELLO Retail installed.
